name: Comfort Control (EaseHub)
description:
GNOME Shell 45–51 panel menu: power buttons, volume, quick toggles (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Airplane Mode, Do Not Disturb, Dark Mode, Night Light, Keep Awake), files and trash, screenshots, system and Flatpak updates, sudo timeout, and optional Files right-click actions. Wayland & X11/Xorg.

Created by Nick Otmazgin.
